title: iRacing US Open Wheel D USF2000 Road America Track Guide

corners.braking: between three cone and one cone, brake to fourth gear
corners.exit: use exit curve, pick up power early

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: between two and one marker boards, brake to third gear
corners.mistakes: people making a mistake, be wary on opening laps

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: Brake to second gear at number two board.
corners.line: Move to right side of track, use camber.
corners.exit: Use all run-off area on exit, be precise.

corners.label: T5
corners.mistakes: Feel off camber, prone to spinning.

corners.label: T7
corners.line: pick up the entry curb, pick up the exit curb
corners.mistakes: don't be afraid of the camber, commit to the corner

corners.label: T9
corners.exit: use exit curb, but no more
corners.mistakes: too far off exit curb leads to spin

corners.label: T12
corners.braking: Break at three board, drop to third gear
corners.line: Use second gear briefly for extra rotation
corners.exit: Flat out, use run-off if needed
corners.mistakes: Don't commit, can feel sketchy on cold tires

corners.line: Use line in road as turning point
corners.mistakes: Critical corner due to long main straight

general_tips: carry lots of speed through turn one
be wary on opening laps in turn three
this section of track called the Hurry Downs
turn eight is a downhill corner
the carousel is tricky to get right
turn one, turn three, turn five, turn six, and turn eight are definite spin points
Be wary of the corner, use run-off if needed
Get a good run out of final corner.
